worldcombat.skill.crosschop.summary: Raise both forearms crossed overhead and drive two chops in from opposite diagonals onto the same locked crossing point in front: the first runs along the real weapon and knocks the guard open, the second cuts down through that crossing spot. Only the same target the first chop hit takes the deeper cut — a target that slips aside in the short interval, or a second chop that lands on a bystander, gets the plain version. A wall stops the chop instead of cutting through it. The double form makes both chops equal and faster but drops the breaking bonus.
Each chop deals %1$s contact damage to the target it hits, settled one after the other.

Once the first chop lands, only the same target it hit takes %1$s extra damage from the second; the two are %2$s ticks apart, so a target that steps off the locked crossing point, or a second chop that lands on a bystander, gets no bonus.
worldcombat.skill.crosschop.stance.guard: Breaking form: the first chop knocks the guard open and the second's breaking bonus is 1.35x; the cost is a slightly shorter reach and a longer interval, wind-up and +6 cooldown ticks.
worldcombat.skill.crosschop.stance.doubl: Double form: both chops are equal, reach is 1.08x and the wind-up is quicker; the cost is no breaking bonus.
worldcombat.skill.crosschop.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.crosschop.growth.0: From level %1$s each chop rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crosschop.growth.1: From level %1$s each chop rises to %2$s and the reach extends to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.crosschop.use.0: Cut one point with two chops that land in turn
worldcombat.skill.crosschop.use.1: Open the guard with the first chop and cut deeper with the second
worldcombat.skill.crosschop.use.2: Settle two contact hits at point-blank
worldcombat.skill.crosschop.preference.g: On: the first chop knocks the guard open and the second cuts a deeper notch into a target it already hit (1.35x breaking bonus), at a slightly shorter reach, a longer interval and wind-up and +6 cooldown ticks. Off: the double form, both chops equal and faster with more reach, but no breaking bonus.
worldcombat.skill.crosschop.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of chopping. Larger values open from a little further out.
On: it raises its priority only within 65% of its reach, so both chops land on the same point. Off: it orders like an ordinary melee attack and chops whenever it can reach.
